text:
sara_cs: Heads-up  Renewal for CarbonNest is next week. Procurement is asking for quarterly POs (4x) instead of a single annual PO, split across two entities and currencies (USD for US ops, SGD for APAC ops). They also require KMS/HSM integration for keys (private deployment) and want onboarding ramped across 3 months. Need pricing + legal + security alignment.
jon_sales: looping in @dina_legal @pete_fin and @zara_security. That PO cadence is new for us. Any quick flags?
dina_legal: We can accept multiple POs if we have a master SOW that binds all 4 POs to the same terms. Need explicit language: "Master SOW governs services; individual POs are payment instruments only." Also require KMS Appendix for customer-managed keys; will involve security review.
pete_fin: Finance: quarterly POs + net60 increases DSO risk. To preserve margins we can keep annual discounted price IF each PO references the Master SOW and includes a one-line acceptance of charges. If they insist on separate invoices per legal entity/currency, we'll need FX reconciliation notes. Also vendor code mapping per entity.
zara_security: KMS/HSM: security review required. For private deployment we need KMS SLA, key rotation procedures, and access controls. This may push countersign slightly. We can do it but need eng signoff and an acceptance test in the SOW.
ops_onboard: Onboarding ramp feasible. We can stage seat activations: month1 = 25%, month2 = 50%, month3 = 100% seats. Reserve 3 enablement sessions across Q1. Full SSO requires final contract or PO with explicit acceptance clause.
sara_cs: Customer (procurement lead) replied at 1738006022: they will issue four POs (one per quarter) with Net60, want annual pricing/discount preserved, and require KMS integration clause. They asked if we can accept FX handling on our side (we would invoice USD and SGD separately).
jon_sales: Proposed approach: Master SOW with annual discounted price, Schedule A = payment plan (quarterly POs), Schedule B = KMS appendix and test plan, invoice appendix mapping entity -> currency. Customer to upload PO per quarter referencing Master SOW #CN-2026.
dina_legal: I'll draft Master SOW language and a KMS Appendix. We should require each PO to include the Master SOW number and a one-line acceptance: "This PO is issued pursuant to Master SOW CN-2026 dated <mm/dd/yyyy>."
pete_fin: If we accept annual price with quarterly POs, add a condition: failure to pay a PO within Net60 => revert to list rates pro rata and suspend seat activation. Need that protection.
zara_security: Also include acceptance test: on-prem KMS integration checklist (network, certs, HSM model), and a 14-day window for security signoff before production keys are accepted.
ops_onboard: Will plan ramp schedule and link to billing: seats unlocked per quarter tied to PO receipt. We'll require PO number visible before unlocking each tranche.
jon_sales: Sent PO template + sample Master SOW excerpt to customer at 1738006501. Asked for legal names, EIN/VAT, and bank details for SGD payouts.
renewal-bot: Reminder  renewal:carbonnest in 6 days. Tasks: legal master SOW, security KMS appendix, finance approval for annual price + quarterly PO flow.
sara_cs: Customer answered at 1738007120: will upload PO1 immediately referencing CN-2026 and provide SGD bank details for APAC entity. They asked if onboarding can begin after PO1 is uploaded and first tranche invoices are issued.
pete_fin: We can allow initial pre-onboarding tasks after PO1 uploaded, but tranche unlocks must align to PO payments. We'll allow view access + initial workshops after PO upload; full production seats unlock after payment clears or after Net60 per our condition.
dina_legal: I'll route the Master SOW + KMS Appendix draft for internal review now. Tagging as non-standard: multi-PO + multi-currency + private-KMS.
jon_sales: I'll follow up with customer EOD if PO1 not uploaded. :thumbsup:

---

Sample PO template (shared with customer):
```
PO # (to be provided by customer): PO-CN-Q1-2026
Master SOW reference: CN-2026
Billing Line 1:
- bill_to: CarbonNest US, Inc (EIN: 54-3210987)
- currency: USD
- scope: US seats (quarter 1 tranche)
Billing Line 2:
- bill_to: CarbonNest APAC Pte Ltd (UEN: 202300111A)
- currency: SGD
- scope: APAC seats (quarter 1 tranche)
Vendor Codes: CN-US, CN-APAC
Payment terms: Net60 (PO required). Please include Master SOW CN-2026 on the PO.
```

jon_sales: DocuSign link for Master SOW (draft): https://docusign.example.com/cn-master-2026 (internal id: RENEW-CN-1738).
